samples.question: The REFERENCE plug face is marked in magenta. In the CABLE BANK, first find the plug with the identical 3x3 black-square pattern; patterns are not rotated or reflected. Then trace its cable downward through all five bands. At an X, continue straight diagonally across the white bridge gap—never turn onto the crossing cable. Which colored socket does it reach: red, green, blue, or orange?
